description: Get the value of one Google Data Commons statistical variable for one place: the latest value (default), the value at a date, or the whole time series. Each value names its original publisher (US Census, World Bank, Eurostat, CDC, ...) and lists how alternate sources differ. Example: variable "Count_Person", place "country/USA".

_apiKey.description: Data Commons API key (free). Get one at https://apikeys.datacommons.org

date.description: LATEST (default), all (full series), or a date: 2019, 2019-06, 2019-06-30

limit.description: With date=all, max observations returned, most recent kept (default 50, max 500)

place.description: Place dcid, e.g. country/USA, geoId/06, Earth (find with datacommons_find_place)

variable.description: Statistical variable dcid, e.g. Count_Person, Median_Income_Household (find with datacommons_find_variable)

name: datacommons_observation
title: Datacommons Observation
